fields.System.Title: RET-5 — Return reporting
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Show which products and customers generate returns, and why — because the pattern usually
points somewhere other than the warehouse.

Scope

In. Return rate by product, by customer, and by reason.

Out. Commercial action on the findings.

Design notes

A high return rate on one product is usually a data problem upstream, not a warehouse
problem. Wrong description, wrong image, wrong size guide, wrong dimensions. This report is the
cheapest way to find those, and the finding goes to whoever owns the product content — not to
the warehouse.

A high return rate for one customer may mean a genuine quality issue, or systematic
over-ordering, or return fraud. The report identifies; a human investigates.

These are historical aggregates, so they belong in a read model refreshed daily.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Live aggregate query degrading over time | [doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
| Return reasons too vague to analyse | [doc 03 §8](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
